["public.weekly_source_upload_context_v1(jsonb)","UUID_CARDINALITY_UNCLASSIFIED","if v_row_client_id is null and v_profile.profile_code='NHSP_PREFINAL_RELEASED_V1' then
      select case when pg_catalog.count(*)=1 then pg_catalog.min(client.id::text)::uuid end
        into v_row_client_id
      from public.clients client
      where private.weekly_source_upload_client_eligible_v1(
          v_upload.id,client.id,v_source_row.work_date)
        and pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(client.name))=
          pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(v_source_client,'')));"]

["public.weekly_source_upload_context_v1(jsonb)","UUID_CARDINALITY_UNCLASSIFIED","else
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
         
        select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
               pg_catalog.min(event.id::text)::uuid
          into v_prior_candidate_count,v_prior_work_event_id
        from public.weekly_work_events event
        where event.first_source_group_id=v_group.id
          and event.source_format_profile_id=v_profile.id
          and event.identity_kind='SCHEDULE_TUPLE'
          and event.candidate_id=v_candidate_id and event.client_id=v_row_client_id
          and event.work_date=v_source_row.work_date
          and private.weekly_source_work_event_schedule_compatible_v1(
                event.id,v_source_row.start_at_local,v_source_row.end_at_local
              );"]

["public.weekly_source_projection_rows_apply_atomic_v1(uuid,uuid,jsonb)","UUID_CARDINALITY_UNCLASSIFIED","select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
                 pg_catalog.min(work_event.id::text)::uuid
            into v_compatible_count,v_compatible_event_id
          from public.weekly_work_events work_event
          where work_event.first_source_group_id=v_group.id
            and work_event.source_format_profile_id=v_upload.source_format_profile_id
            and work_event.identity_kind='SCHEDULE_TUPLE'
            and work_event.candidate_id=v_candidate_id
            and work_event.client_id=v_client_id
            and work_event.work_date=v_source_row.work_date
            and private.weekly_source_work_event_schedule_compatible_v1(
                  work_event.id,v_source_row.start_at_local,v_source_row.end_at_local
                );"]

["public.invoice_apply_edits(uuid,jsonb,uuid)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","for v_refupd in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_reference_updates) value loop
    if v_refupd is not null and jsonb_typeof(v_refupd)='object' then
      select min(field_name) into v_source_unsupported_field
      from jsonb_object_keys(v_refupd) field_name
      where not (field_name=any(v_allowed_reference_fields));"]

["public.invoice_apply_edits(uuid,jsonb,uuid)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","for v_location_update in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_location_updates) value loop
    if v_location_update is not null and jsonb_typeof(v_location_update)='object' then
      select min(field_name) into v_source_unsupported_field
      from jsonb_object_keys(v_location_update) field_name
      where not (field_name=any(v_allowed_location_fields));"]

["public.invoice_apply_edits(uuid,jsonb,uuid)","AGGREGATE_TYPE_UNCLASSIFIED","select min(field_name) into v_source_unsupported_field\n            from jsonb_object_keys(v_source_payload_segment) field_name\n            where not (field_name=any(v_allowed_reference_segment_fields));"]
